title: Story premise ENT083: The Eraser’s Overtime
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (creative-work struggles). Hook: The eraser has done more work than the pencil. Takeaway/theme: An imperfect attempt may contain the part you need.
description: An illustrator wants a clean first line and erases every stroke until the paper becomes a transparent window. Looking through the hole reveals the messy sketch beneath, which already contains the desired pose; they trace only its strongest contour and let the rest stay loose.
